- an Opus 5.5 max owner on ref-e44df808f581ff079ac4: ref-4189c1615990eb515921, READY 23:14:43. I minted it at 23:11 for MAINLINE-008, relieving the muse-walled ref-454ea8a33cb537f77738, on the second Opus row Engineering freed (Boyce's order: walled muse leads move to Opus). Your 23:12 order puts 008b on ref-3889d7468b48dd3d482f, so this seat is free for whichever card you name.
Pools now: ref-a16c596268c92750edfc 6 of 6 (7d 95 percent at 23:16), ref-e44df808f581ff079ac4 4 of 4, ref-3e199f7e15cdec86a8ae 4 of 4, muse and codex walled. ref-a31873e5ad9108cdd2cc holds one seat but has no lead row except Fable, which the crew rule refuses; Engineering builds the Opus row (route 2). The next card needs a retirement or that row.
